mapper.select: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_number, first_item.product_name AS first_product_name, item_summary.item_count, s.shipping_status, s.carrier, s.tracking_number, s.created_at, s.shipped_at, s.delivered_at, s.cancelled_at FROM ORDERS o JOIN SHIPPING s ON s.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_id, MIN(order_item_id) AS first_order_item_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM ORDER_ITEM GROUP BY order_id ) item_summary ON item_summary.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM first_item ON first_item.order_item_id = item_summary.first_order_item_id WHERE o.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY o.order_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS o JOIN SHIPPING s ON s.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.member_id = #{memberId}
